description:
## T.M Bethany Clinic — We're Hiring!

**T.M Bethany Clinic** is a healthcare facility located at **Plot 75 Kinawataka Road, Eddwaliro**, dedicated to providing quality health services. Our motto: *"Your health is our focus."*

We are currently seeking qualified and motivated **Midwives** to join our team. There are **2 open positions**.

## Positions Available

| Qualification | Number of Positions |
|---|---|
| Diploma in Midwifery | 1 |
| Certificate in Midwifery | 1 |

## Key Responsibilities

- Provide antenatal, intrapartum and postnatal care to mothers and newborns
- Conduct normal deliveries and manage uncomplicated obstetric cases
- Monitor the health of mothers and babies during and after delivery
- Provide family planning counselling and services
- Immunise children and maintain immunisation records
- Health education and community outreach on maternal and child health
- Maintain accurate patient records and clinical documentation
- Sterilise and maintain delivery equipment and clinical areas
- Refer complicated cases to higher-level facilities in a timely manner

## Requirements

- **Diploma in Midwifery** OR **Certificate in Midwifery** from a recognised institution
- Must be registered with the Uganda Nurses and Midwives Council (UNMC)
- Valid practising licence
- Commitment to professional ethics and patient safety
- Good interpersonal and communication skills
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team

## How to Apply

Interested and suitably qualified candidates should send their applications to:

📧 **bethanyhomecareclinic@gmail.com**

> **Note:** No hand-delivered applications will be accepted.

## Contact

📞 **0789 431 405** / **0752 787 332**

## Deadline

All applications must be received by **20th September 2026**.
